claim: The id_brut_miom bureau-de-vote identifier scheme used to join French election results across cycles produces mismatching codes for the same physical bureau de vote between the Ministry of Interior's own published source data and the aggregated dataset's derived identifiers, requiring manual correction by the maintainers.
stance_target: French bureau-level crosswalk is structurally unstable / not maintained via a strict national norm
scope_conditions: Législatives 2024, commune de Montbéliard (Doubs); reported Feb 2026, fixed same month
quoted_support: Certains bureaux de vote ne correspondent plus avec ceux données par le ministère de l'intérieur. Par exemple, aux législatives 2024, à Montbéliard, on a des 0X01, 0X02... au lieu de 0E11, 0E321 au tour 1.

claim: Overseas French territory (DOM-TOM) département-code prefixes were systematically mis-mapped in the aggregated elections pipeline, causing commune codes for Mayotte, New Caledonia, French Polynesia, and Wallis-et-Futuna to collide with unrelated metropolitan/overseas département codes.
stance_target: table-bv-reu/id_brut_miom crosswalk has systematic, not just idiosyncratic, ID-mapping bugs
scope_conditions: reported Feb 2026 against 2026 municipales export; affects overseas territories specifically
quoted_support: ZM (Mayotte): j'observe 975 au lieu de 976 (INSEE) - ZN (Nouvelle-Calédonie): j'observe 978 au lieu de 988 - ZP (Polynésie): j'observe 970/977 au lieu de 987 - ZW (Wallis-et-Futuna): j'observe 970 au lieu de 986

claim: A separate user reported a corrupted/malformed bureau-de-vote code for Montbéliard in the 2020 municipales source file itself (spreadsheet scientific-notation artifact), propagating into the aggregated dataset as a mismatched key relative to the 2024 législatives code for the same commune.
stance_target: source-data quality issues (not just redistricting) also break bureau-level joins across years
quoted_support: certains codes de bureaux de vote de Montbeliard son incorrects: '25388_0,00E+00' pour id_election = '2020_muni_t1' et id_brut_miom = '25388_0000' pour id_election = '2024_legi_t1'

claim: The data.gouv.fr aggregated elections dataset carries no circonscription (constituency) code at all for the 2024 législatives because the Ministry of Interior's own source publication omitted it, even though the field is present and populated for the 2022 législatives — illustrating that upstream source-data completeness, not just bureau geography, varies unpredictably across cycles.
stance_target: reliability of cross-cycle joins/attributes in the aggregated dataset
quoted_support: les circonscriptions sont bien dans le fichier ... si l'information est dans les données sources du Ministère de l'intérieur ... Pour les législatives 2024, le MI n'a pas renseigné la circonscription dans les publications.

claim: A Sciences Po dataset (data.sciencespo.fr) exists that chains individual CANDIDATES (not bureaux) across successive French elections at the constituency level via name/first-name/date-of-birth matching, with an accompanying R script handling homonymy and spelling variants — evidence that even at the coarser constituency/candidate level, cross-election matching in France required a bespoke fuzzy-matching solution rather than a stable shared identifier.
stance_target: existence of established cross-election ID stability infrastructure in France
scope_conditions: French legislative elections, constituency level, candidate identity
quoted_support: nous avons créé ce jeu de données pour suivre les candidats d'une élection à l'autre ... On propose en plus un script R de chaînage sur la base du nom, du prénom et de la date de naissance quand elle est disponible. On essaye de gérer au mieux les problèmes d'homonymie et de variations orthographiques.

claim: The aggregated elections dataset's own description explicitly warns that its underlying data structure changed in January 2026, and the join mechanism is table-bv-reu.csv linking id_election + id_brut_miom fields to the INSEE REU, confirming the join is a versioned, per-update artifact rather than a fixed static schema.
stance_target: table-bv-reu.csv is not a static crosswalk but a periodically-revised, maintenance-dependent artifact
quoted_support: /!\ la structure des données a évolué en janvier 2026 ... Les jointures se font par l'intermédiaire de la table de conversion des identifiants des bureaux de vote (table-bv-reu.csv).
time_period: January 2026 structure change; last updated July 7, 2026
